canvas.label: Design canvas
canvas.moved: Moved to X {{x}} mm, Y {{y}} mm
canvas.rows: Up to {{n}} rows · On overflow: reject

state.noPublished: There is no published version to show yet.

toasts.migrated: The design was upgraded to the latest format. A recovery copy is kept for 30 days.

errors.editRefused: This change could not be applied.
errors.saveInvalid: The design could not be saved because it is not valid.
errors.tooLarge: The design is too large to save.
errors.schemaChanged: The data fields changed. The design was reloaded.

reason.schemaUnavailable: Data fields are unavailable right now.
reason.absoluteOnly: Available on a fixed canvas only.
reason.notInZone: Not allowed in the header or footer.

hybrid.positionHint: Body items stay in flow. Set header/footer heights in Page setup to enable free positioning there.
hybrid.positionUnavailable: This structural item cannot change position mode.
hybrid.groupInFlow: Groups cannot be converted to flow. Use Convert layout for the document.
hybrid.rotationInFlow: Set rotation to zero before moving this item into flow.
hybrid.pageFieldInFlow: Page fields must remain in a header or footer.
hybrid.typeInZone: This item type is not allowed in a header or footer.
hybrid.configureZone: Set this zone’s height in Page setup first.
hybrid.flowZone: Enable free positioning for this zone in Page setup.
hybrid.zoneHint: Header/footer zone. Select it, then add an item to this zone.
hybrid.freeHint: Drag to move. Resize with the handles. Arrow keys: 1 mm; Shift: 5 mm.
hybrid.flowHint: Drag to reorder in flow or drop into a fixed header/footer. Side handles change width; the bottom handle changes minimum height.
hybrid.sizeUnavailable: This structural item has no resize handles; use its properties to change its layout.
hybrid.locked: Unlock this item to move or resize it.
hybrid.zoneHeightHint: Height in mm (1–80). Enter a height to add a fixed zone; existing zones keep their content. Blank keeps the current zone.
hybrid.zoneHeightError: Header and footer heights must be between 1 and 80 mm.
hybrid.explanation: Hybrid: body items stay in flow; fixed headers and footers allow free positioning. Click to open Convert layout (also in ⋯). Choose Fixed canvas for free positioning everywhere.

insert.FLOW: Adds to the body in flow. Then click a fixed header/footer to place it freely, or drag to reorder.
insert.header: Adds freely positioned content to the header. Drag or resize it inside the zone.
insert.footer: Adds freely positioned content to the footer. Drag or resize it inside the zone.

hybrid.overflow: An item extends beyond its fixed zone. Move or resize it to fit.
hybrid.measurementRequired: The current content must be visible and measurable before converting this zone.
hybrid.columnResize: Column width follows its row percentages. Use the bottom handle to change minimum height.
